summary: Backend-only first-finish validation against public URL. All 14 requested backend features are working. Demo seed, auth, menu, orders, cash/card/UPI payments (incl. 12s demo auto-pay), UrbanPiper webhook routing, online-order simulation, stock toggle with UP sync flag, order status transitions, dashboard, and multi-tenant isolation all verified end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/auth/login demo/demo123 returns JWT (field: token) + store object
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns demo store (username=demo)
POST /api/orders creates order with correct subtotal/tax/total and ORD##### auto-increment (observed ORD00003..ORD00008)
POST /api/orders/{id}/pay/card with reference sets payment_status=Paid, payment_ref stored (verified via GET /api/orders/{id})
POST /api/orders/{id}/pay/upi/initiate returns upi_string containing pa=, am=, cu=, tn= and demo_mode=true
GET /api/orders/{id}/pay/upi/status flips Pending -> Paid after ~12s demo auto-pay (payment_ref=pay_demo_*)
POST /api/webhooks/urbanpiper with store_ref=UP-DEMO-001 creates Swiggy order on demo store
POST /api/menu/{id}/toggle-stock flips is_available and returns synced_to_urbanpiper=true
GET /api/dashboard returns today_sales, today_orders, channels, payment_modes, recent
POST /api/stores/register creates second tenant; second store sees 0 orders and isolated menu
UrbanPiper webhook with second store's store_ref correctly routes order to second tenant (channel=Zomato)
contract_notes_for_frontend: UPI initiate response field is `upi_string` (not upi_link/deep_link); also returns amount, amount_paise, razorpay_order_id, demo_mode, order_number
Payment endpoints return {ok:true}; frontend should refetch order or rely on /pay/upi/status for UPI
